APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

17 oz tumbler

Corporate Events & Branded Gifts ↗

A 17 oz acrylic tumbler with a lid and straw: Logo on the side and it becomes the cup staff and clients carry every day.

Beach Parties ↗

The lid keeps sand out and the straw means you are not wiping the rim every time.

Camping & Outdoor ↗

Lidded, so a trail walk does not end in a wet pack.

Confirm for your project

Check the printable area, what goes in the set and how it is packed；the venue's no-glass rule, wind and sand exposure, and how it gets washed；packed size, pack space and the temperature of hot drinks.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
